_note: The apps KH Updater manages on a Mac, by bundle identifier. 'Install KH Updater.command' looks in ~/Applications and /Applications for one of these bundles and records the ones it finds. 'hub' and 'story' are status only: those two keep their own updaters, which let running work finish first. Only 'gateway' is stopped and replaced by KH Updater. Relay is recorded even when it is not installed, so a Mac can install it from the feed. Add a line here if an app ships under a new bundle identifier; nothing else has to change.
